name: SeamUI
summary: MIT Base UI + motion.dev shadcn registry with depth springs, haptics, and agent UI.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 67+ SeamUI foundation/docs components (AI/voice/workbench tiers not fully covered).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Base UI button with seam depth press motion.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @seamui/button

# Or: bunx --bun @seamui/cli@latest add button
# Registry: https://seamui.dev/r/button.json
# Demo: https://seamui.dev/docs/components/button

copyPrompt.text: Use SeamUI free MIT React component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://seamui.dev/docs/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @seamui/button` (registry https://seamui.dev/r/{name}.json) or `bunx --bun @seamui/cli@latest add button`. Built on Base UI + motion.dev. Home: https://seamui.dev. Repo: https://github.com/meiskv/seamui. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/meiskv/seamui/main/LICENSE; Copyright (c) 2026 Mikhail Villamor). Pricing free.
